answer: Fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 60 credits in a basalt vault, unlocked in stages as its fingerprint — the ripple of task timing — matches its past. Auditors match each fingerprint against the ledge of past patterns: a rented print means one hand behind two names, and the escrow burns. First fake costs 46, the k-th 46+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,542,500 plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 46 once.
